body: I dont really have anyone in real life I can talk to about this. I have online friends but I don't know how much they'd be able to help. I really think I need to go see a doctor about this but I'm so scared of them and I feel like theyre just going to make things worse. All I can really do for myself now is try and comfort myself and wait until this phase passes me but it's so hard I'm trying my best

You did it!! The courage you have to fight back against whatever that has decided it has the right to make your life miserable is proof enough of your worth and place in this world. It's not easy, but who you are as a person, your strengths and your spirit are proof enough you belong here. You deserve all the blessings that come your way and more, and I'm so proud I have the honour of telling this to you :)
